exercises.why: **поучай** — поуча́ть (imperfective): (dated) to teach, to instruct; to preach (at), to lecture, to give a lecture. Wiktionary: по- + учи́ть + -а́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to learn (to completion, typically something involving rote memorisation)
(intransitive) to learn, to study; to train for
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́учить — to learn (to completion, typically something involving rote memorisation); поуче́ние — lecture, sermon, lesson, homily; вы́учиться — (intransitive) to learn, to study; to train for; учи́тельница — female teacher, female instructor.
**ученицы** — учени́ца: female pupil, schoolgirl; female pupil, apprentice; female disciple, follower. Wiktionary: учен(и́к) + -и́ца.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
